title: Pediatric Adeno-Tonsillar Hypertrophy Treatment Post-Approval Study
official: Pediatric Adeno-Tonsillar Hypertrophy Treatment Post-Approval Study
summary:
This study is a prospective, multi-center, single-arm study of pediatric subjects (age 3-12) with Sleep-Disordered Breathing ("SDB") due to adeno-tonsillar hypertrophy which are treated with the ENTire IRE System.

Subjects will be followed for six (6) months post-treatment. The objective of the study is to provide an ongoing safety and effectiveness assessment of the ENTire IRE System in treating pediatric adeno-tonsillar hypertrophy.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients are 3-12 years of age.
* Tonsillar hypertrophy of grade 2 or more on the Brodsky Grading System for Tonsils ("BGST").
* Children with SDB scheduled for adeno-tonsillar surgery after an otolaryngology evaluation.

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Patients with a pacemaker, cochlear or similar electro stimulator implants.
2. Patients for whom the anesthesia involves high risk.
3. Significant illness (e.g., cancer, severe autoimmune disease, neurological disease, severe heart disease).
4. Craniofacial anomalies.
5. Patients which underwent prior tonsillectomy or tonsillotomy.
6. Epilepsy or other conditions involving convulsions.
7. Parent/Guardian inability to give informed consent and to complete reported questionnaires.
8. Any other reason the investigator deems the subject is unfit for participation in the study.
